meta.name: apollo-install-auth
meta.description:
Install and configure Apollo.io API authentication.
Use when setting up a new Apollo integration, configuring API keys,
or initializing Apollo client in your project.
Trigger with phrases like "install apollo", "setup apollo api",
"apollo authentication", "configure apollo api key".

howto.what: Claude 会安装 Apollo.io 所需的依赖,配置 API 密钥,创建客户端连接,并通过健康检查验证认证是否成功。

say.note: Claude 会执行安装和配置步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude installs required dependencies for Apollo.io, configures the API key, creates a client connection, and verifies authentication via a health check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "install apollo", "setup apollo api", "apollo authentication", or similar phrases, or when setting up a new Apollo integration, configuring API keys, or initializing an Apollo client.

say_en.text: Install the Apollo API and configure authentication.
say_en.note: Claude will run installation and configuration steps.

say_en.text: Set up the Apollo API key for my project.
say_en.note: Claude will create an environment variable or .env file.

say_en.text: Initialize an Apollo client and verify the connection.
say_en.note: Claude will create the client and check the health endpoint.
